**Pre-Resale Test Checklist (paymentd PCs/Servers/Laptops)**

1. `[ ]` Intake log: brand/model, CPU, RAM, storage, GPU, serial/service tag, included accessories.  
2. `[ ]` Visual inspection: cracks, dents, missing screws, corrosion, liquid damage, bent ports.  
3. `[ ]` Boot/POST test: powers on cleanly, no POST errors/beeps, BIOS accessible.  
4. `[ ]` Firmware: BIOS/UEFI date/version recorded; reset to defaults after testing.  
5. `[ ]` RAM test: full pass (MemTest or vendor diagnostics), no errors.  
6. `[ ]` Storage health: SMART checked, no critical warnings, bad-sector scan pass.  
7. `[ ]` CPU/GPU stress: 20–30 min load test; no crashes, throttling, or thermal shutdowns.  
8. `[ ]` Thermals/noise: idle/load temps recorded; fans spin normally; no abnormal noise.  
9. `[ ]` Ports/peripherals: USB, video outputs, audio, Ethernet, Wi‑Fi, Bluetooth all tested.  
10. `[ ]` Display/input (laptops/AIO): panel uniformity, dead pixels, keyboard, trackpad, webcam, mic, speakers.  
11. `[ ]` Battery (laptops): charge/discharge test; battery health/cycle count recorded.  
12. `[ ]` Server-specific: RAID status, all drive bays, IPMI/iDRAC/iLO access, PSU redundancy, NICs.  
13. `[ ]` OS install + activation state: clean install boots normally, device manager has no unknown devices.  
14. `[ ]` Data sanitization: secure wipe completed and logged (drive serial + wipe method + date).  
15. `[ ]` Final grading: cosmetic grade (A/B/C), known defects list, final tested date and tester initials.  

---

**eBay Buyer-Trust Photo Shot-List**

1. Hero photo: powered on, clean background, entire unit visible.  
2. Front/back/left/right/top/bottom photos (full exterior coverage).  
3. Close-ups of model label and serial/service tag (mask part of serial if desired).  
4. Port close-ups (USB, HDMI/DP, Ethernet, power, etc.) proving condition.  
5. Screen-on proof image (desktop/BIOS visible, no heavy glare).  
6. BIOS/UEFI system info photo (CPU/RAM/storage detected).  
7. Storage health proof photo (SMART status screen).  
8. Stress-test proof photo (temps/utilization during load).  
9. Laptop battery proof photo (health/cycle count report).  
10. Any defects: clear close-ups of scratches, dents, worn keys, blemishes.  
11. Included accessories laid out (charger, rails, caddies, adapters, etc.).  
12. Shipping-prep photo (unit cushioned/boxed) to signal careful handling.

---

**Quick listing trust boosters**

1. Use consistent lighting/background and high resolution across all photos.  
2. Match listing specs exactly to tested results; avoid “untested” if you ran diagnostics.  
3. Include a short “Tested on: YYYY-MM-DD” block with pass/fail notes in the description.
